items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I know that with the duets with Lonnie Johnson it was really interesting

ctx.x: I don’t know his playing that well but I remember kind of like the father of modern kind of guitar. One of the fathers of modern guitar for sure but I remember his playing to be

very, I don’t know if virtuosic is the right word but he was more of a kind of almost like a soloist, like a real complete kind of guitarist. Could play chord melodies and kind of like a piano. He was more like a piano player when he played alone. I know that with the duets with Lonnie Johnson it was really interesting because you could hear these two really very different styles. Eddie sounded very, very calculated and in a way, very clean. And then of course Lonnie was more of a blues player. So I thought it…
